description:
Every job the catalog is grouped by, with the canonical request and response each provider of that job is mapped onto — which is what lets an agent swap one endpoint for another without changing its code. Static: no market figures here, because each one costs its own catalog walk. Ask `/unified/{slug}` for a capability's offers and going rate. Send `fields=compact` when you are only choosing a capability: the full response carries both IO schemas for all of them.

Wraps GET /v0/unified.
Access: no API key required.

Returns:
- capabilities: Slug, name, group, priced unit and — on `fields=full` — summary and the canonical input/output fields.
- count: How many capabilities the registry defines.
- fields: Which shape was served: `full` or `compact`.
- note: Where the market figures for one capability live.

fields.description: `compact` returns slug, name, group and unit only — enough to pick a capability, without 34 pairs of IO schemas in the payload.

name: list_capabilities
title: The capability catalogue
